articles.title: OMCs reject Karnataka’s high-ethanol fuel claim, seek fresh tests
articles.description: State-run oil marketers in India have rejected Karnataka's claims regarding excessive ethanol content in petrol sold. They argue that the state's testing procedures lack adherence to prescribed standards and were unverified. The oil companies assert that their E20 fuel adheres to Bureau of Indian Standards and undergoes strict quality checks. They highlighted that previous tests indicated compliance within the mandated ethanol blending range.

articles.title: Electric vehicle sales jump 45% to 3,54,625 units in October, led by e-two wheelers and burgeoning demand
articles.description: Electric vehicle sales in India experienced significant growth in October, reaching 354,625 units. E-two-wheeler sales contributed most, totaling 224,064 units this year. There was also a notable increase in e-passenger vehicles, with volumes rising to 37,049 units. Electric three-wheelers grew to 88,570 units, continuing the overall upward trend in the EV market. The report indicates that demand continues to exceed supply due to rising fuel prices.

articles.title: Tesla IPO investors turned $1,000 into $242,000: Can its $1.52 trillion valuation deliver another big payday for shareholders?

The company’s high market price suggests optimism for future innovations in AI, like Robotaxis and Optimus. New shareholders face challenges compared to those who invested early.

articles.title: ‘Loser’ Elon Musk Lost $80 Bn In An Afternoon: Is He On The Democrat ‘Hitlist’ Now?
articles.description: Elon Musk lost $80 billion in a single afternoon as Wall Street crashed after the US midterms, pushing his net worth below $800 billion. Days earlier, he had spent a record of nearly half a billion dollars trying to help Republicans win. They lost. Now Democrats control Congress and are eyeing probes into DOGE, his government contracts and Starlink. Is the world’s richest man in real trouble, or are these just paper losses? Meghna Deka decodes if Musk is on the Democrat ‘hitlist’.
